review_questions.scope: C3 corruption detection versus finite stop
review_questions.question: Differentiate invariant-based command completeness from detecting corrupt producer history. After collecting N and stopping, a later surplus is unseen; an AND predicate excludes wrong-observation rows instead of automatically flagging them. Pin an anomaly predicate and observation window or qualify the guarantee; do not demand an unbounded scan by default.
review_questions.acceptance: Valid interleaving/N0/exhaustion are retained, corruption guarantees neither overclaimed nor hidden.

review_questions.question: Consolidated P2.2 wording about observations not targeted by terminal correction must be read with R2 at-most-one-effective-replacement and superseded-replacement exclusion. REPLACE O4->O5 then RETRACT O4 must exclude both O4/O5; REPLACE O4->O5 then REPLACE O4->O6 leaves onlyO6. Confirm a single explicit canonical derivation rather than taking the short sentence literally.
review_questions.acceptance: No original or superseded replacement resurfaces; history remains immutable; no correction-of-correction target invented.

review_questions.question: P1.3 calls the recommended order uniform for every command. Confirm filing/observation/correction-family scope and compatibility with existing command contracts; do not silently create a global command-order change outside this F10 task. Pin supplement target-vs-CAS handling and existing428/412/409 expectations.
review_questions.acceptance: No unrelated command contract superseded by scoped addendum.

review_questions.question: Review proposed limits reason2000/type64/correlation128 as proposed values, not sourced policy; envelope/UTF8-vs-characters/overflow bounds remain explicit where absent. Existing32catalogue stays; zero route/filter delta still includes new payload/field/semantics.
review_questions.acceptance: One concrete decision packet after review; no production byte/latency or approved-limit claim.

prose_walks.prose_trace_method: Pure document interpretation of stop-at-N and AND-predicate; no runtime code or design acceptance
prose_walks.interpretation: Healthy trace passes under candidate emission/count invariants. Claimed corruption detection must be conditional or have an explicit broader anomaly predicate/window. These are independent review questions, not asserted live-product failures.
